answer: PoA raises the cost of Sybil identities by requiring each claimed identity to sustain a prescribed chain of modular squarings and provide a verifiable Wesolowski VDF proof. Because each squaring depends on the previous result, GPUs can run separate chains in parallel but cannot compress the elapsed time for one chain. Each clone therefore requires its own sequential work; canyon, zephyr, and vault labels do not remove that bottleneck.
